property_summary: The reference contract never sets intitalized to true when SetMinSum is called (so MinSum can still be later changed by a subsequent SetMinSum before Initialized() is called), whereas the mutant makes the first SetMinSum call freeze MinSum by setting intitalized=true; thus: for any fuzzed actor and value, calling SetMinSum once then calling SetLogFile and Initialized() should leave MinSum equal to the last-set value only in the reference for all admissible inputs, while the mutant can cause MinSum to be frozen earlier and differ (we test that calling SetMinSum twice with two fuzzed values leaves MinSum equal to the second value in the reference but may not in the mutant).
change_summary: Replace the body to set MinSum only when not intitalized and also set intitalized to true (so first call sets and freezes value).
